visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The female creator stands centrally against a backdrop of organized white shelving, holding multiple foundation bottles from luxury brands. She wears a white mesh top, her hair is tied, and she smiles confidently while her hands are occupied with the products in front of her chest. (2) A vertical split-screen appears showing the 'Before' and 'After' states of the creator's skin using the DECORTÉ foundation. She holds the black glass bottle to the camera, tilting her head slowly to demonstrate the light-reflecting properties on her cheek under bright studio lighting. (3) The scene cuts to a new review for MAQuillAGE foundation. On the right, her skin appears dewy in the 'After' section. She holds the small pinkish bottle, gesturing towards her face while text ratings for hydration and coverage are overlaid at the bottom. (4) Shiseido foundation is featured in a similar split-screen format. The creator shows the white bottle with red text. Her skin exhibits a high-shine 'glass skin' finish on the 'After' side, and she maintains a neutral, pleasant facial expression throughout the shot. (5) Transitioning to the ARMANI foundation, the woman displays the black-capped bottle. The finish shown on her face is noticeably more matte and velvety compared to previous products. She looks directly into the camera lens with slight adjustments in head angle. (6) The shu uemura segment features the creator holding the square glass bottle. The 'After' shot highlights a semi-matte, natural glow. She points slightly to her cheek to draw attention to the texture, with Traditional Chinese text clarifying skin type suitability. (7) Finally, she presents the GUERLAIN foundation bottle. She points to her jawline to show the seamless blend. The background remains the same shelves of figurines. Text overlays provide final ratings for longevity and hydration, completing the comparative list.

The production is studio-clean with a wide spectral range and no audible environmental noise or SFX throughout the entire duration.
